title: [v0.7.0] Kubernetes: establish a namespace-scoped runtime foundation
author: mcpdev80

comments.author: mcpdev80
comments.body: Architecture rule accepted for future provider work: application contracts describe portable **capabilities, not infrastructure products**. Concrete products are selected by environment/platform-owned providers. Every default BaseHarbor component must have a provider boundary plus a documented replacement path, and unsupported guarantees must fail explicitly rather than silently degrade. Implementation guidance is being documented in ADR `docs/decisions/0005-capabilities-not-products.md` and `docs/capability-provider-model.md`. This does not expand v0.2.0 scope; Compose remains the current implementation focus.
